data.long_meaning: Birsa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhrāmaras' which means 'strong, powerful or fierce'. Parents who choose Birsa usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

His name became synonymous with the struggle for freedom and social justice, inspiring generations of Indian activists and revolutionaries.
